text: 沪深京三市午后大幅放量，成交额自9月22日以来再度突破2万亿元，较昨日放量3251亿元，市场活跃度显著提升。
text_en: The Shanghai, Shenzhen and Beijing stock markets saw a sharp increase in volume in the afternoon, with turnover exceeding 2 trillion yuan again since September 22, up 325.1 billion yuan from yesterday, and market activity significantly improved.
